程序包 org.bukkit.block.data.type

接口 Vault

所有超级接口:
BlockData, java.lang.Cloneable, Directional
public interface Vault extends Directional
'vault_state' 表示宝库方块当前的运行阶段.
'ominous' 表示方块是否具有不祥效果.

原文： 'vault_state' indicates the current operational phase of the vault block.
'ominous' indicates if the block has ominous effects.
